title: One connector's declaration
description: What connectors/<name>.yml holds in a directory that `ingestion connectors apply` sends, and each entry of an applied set's connectors. A poll or a folder runs on its schedule. A drop or a push runs as its items arrive, and is due its due_interval after its last delivery. The service checks each declaration against this file.

name.description: The connector's name, which its file is named for.

source.description: The external feed the connector reads, by its name in the data catalog.

contract.description: The contract the source's payloads hold to.

schedule.description: A poll's or a folder's schedule: five cron fields, a descriptor such as @hourly, or @every 15m, read in UTC unless a CRON_TZ=<zone> prefix names another zone. A poll's once polls until one poll ends done, having landed every item its source holds, and never polls after it.

due_interval.description: How long after its last delivery a drop or a push is due again.

freshness.description: How long a poll or a folder may go without a delivery before it reads overdue.

tags.description: The tags every item the connector lands carries on its sighting.

zone.description: Who writes the content the connector carries, as its items' default: outside for an outsider, owner for the owner.

read_rule.description: How an item the connector landed is read where no tag's rule decides: as-is, or a model read. Left out, the side's default decides.

root.description: The [serve.homes] root a folder connector reads.

path.description: The directory below the root a folder connector reads, with forward slashes. Left out, it reads the whole root.

format.description: The drop handler that splits a drop connector's file into items, by the name the build registers it under. Left out, a dropped file lands as one item.

after_landing.description: What a poll's source does with each item once it has landed. delete removes it, such as a save from a capture playlist, through the deleter its source registers. Left out, the source keeps it.

person_sorts.description: true keeps the quality gate's side guess from placing an item the connector sighted. The item waits in review as person-sorts, with the guess beside it. A tag or a routing rule still places it first.

source_parameters.description: The source's own settings for this connector, such as the playlist that a video source reads. The source names the keys it takes and checks each value when the set is applied. A source that takes none refuses them.

interval.description: A positive count of minutes, hours, days or weeks, such as 90m, 12h, 30d or 2w. A day is 24 hours.
